title: Sub-shell energies up to 4p
caption: Each box is an orbital: one per s, three per p, five per d. Energy rises up the page (not to scale). The 4s sub-shell lies just below 3d, so it fills first.
alt: An energy ladder of empty orbital boxes: 1s at the bottom, then 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, 4s, 3d and 4p at the top.
description: 4s is drawn below 3d, the first place the energy order differs from the shell order.
